definition.en: Export promotion refers to a set of government policies and incentives designed to encourage domestic producers to sell their goods and services in international markets.
definition.hi: Export promotion refers to a set of government policies and incentives designed to encourage domestic producers to sell their goods and services in international markets.

importanceInUpsc.en: This topic is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it directly relates to India's balance of payments, industrial growth, and employment generation. Understanding export promotion mechanisms helps in analyzing trade policies, foreign exchange reserves, and India's integration into global value chains.
